preciousMetalsCategoryReview.investorAccessAndEligibility: Verify actual current FoF scheme identity, underlying ETF, current SID/KIM, riskometer, NAV, KYC and source rights. Historical filed documents are not current authorization.
preciousMetalsCategoryReview.financialProfileScreening: Use only recorded short horizon, emergency-fund goal, zero-month emergency buffer or conservative risk preference to show non-ranking silver ETF FoF volatility, underlying ETF tracking, layered fees, NAV and redemption-settlement review notices. Physical bullion assay, dealer-spread and custody warnings do not describe FoF units. Do not infer eligibility or assign a product riskometer.
riskConsiderations: Underlying silver ETF price and tracking differences can transmit volatile commodity losses to a FoF's NAV.
Two fund layers, ETF spreads, liquidity and redemption settlement can increase realised costs and losses.
The FoF and its underlying silver ETF are separate schemes: a generic commodity risk label or an ETF's historical risk-o-meter cannot be copied into a current FoF risk-o-meter.
investorAccessConstraints: Verify actual current silver FoF and underlying ETF, AMC/ISIN, SID/KIM, riskometer, NAV and KYC; historical filings are not proof of live availability.
Check redemption terms, expense layers, tax classification, lawful licensed price data and investor permissions before any product display.
Verify both schemes and their current risk disclosures, plus the FoF's actual direct/regular plan expenses, underlying ETF units, KYC, redemption terms and licensed NAV data.

october2026MutualFundRiskDisclosureRevie.categoryInterpretation: A silver ETF FoF and its underlying ETF have distinct scheme portfolios, NAVs, costs and risk disclosures. The November 2024 SEBI circular standardises scheme risk-o-meter presentation and separate direct/regular plan expense disclosure; neither source verifies any current silver FoF or underlying ETF.
riskConsiderations: Silver price movements and ETF tracking differences can affect FoF NAV, while a second fund layer may add costs and redemption settlement risk.
A published scheme risk-o-meter is not a price-loss guarantee, and the underlying ETF's risk disclosure is not a substitute for the FoF's own current disclosure.
investorAccessConstraints: Check the named FoF and underlying ETF, latest SID/KIM, separate current risk disclosures and actual direct/regular plan expense information before assessing an investment.
Confirm actual investor KYC, account/transaction eligibility, current NAV and lawful data rights; regulatory publications grant no retail or personalized-advice approval.
